title: 第三十章  入梦非夜
content_zh:
“我想起来了，这个鸟我一直都觉得很眼熟，怪不得。”墨攻行一拍脑袋，接着道：“当初吴鹿城的傩队里，就有带这个的面具，因为鸟嘴很大，所以我有印象。”

    “嗯，伯奇鸟是十二兽之一，因为其食梦，所以用来桀杀梦魔。”玉京子说。

    “呀！那我的夜用他，是不是就可以不用做梦了。”芊芊显得有些兴奋。

    “仅仅靠画估计不行，瑶的情况很特殊，普通人不能和她比。”玉京子摇摇头。

    “那你能不能把怀梦草借给我们，我进到他的梦里看看。”墨攻行望着玉京子。

    “这个没有问题，但是我奉劝你们，最好不要这样做。”玉京子的表情分外严肃。

    “孤已经进入天人境多年，心性已定。这些年在瑶的教导下，对梦的掌控力已经很强。即便这样，还是出现了一些偏差，我本来是想直接送你去云梦台，结果还是出现了葬云山和羽山。”

    “连我都是如此，你们普通人的梦境更是可想而知，内容光怪陆离，难以捉摸。如果是噩梦，那更加凶险万分。若精神力被困在梦境，后果会不堪设想，轻则变成痴呆，重则殒命当场。”

    墨非夜看到墨攻行，一脸轻松的样子，没想到入梦如此凶险。

    长期困扰他的噩梦，他都只能回忆出一些碎片。如果真能进去看看，也许能知道自己噩梦的真相。

    说不定还能解开土城，所有生物消失的秘密。

    现在听到墨攻行会有生死之患，是断不能让墨攻行去冒这么大的险。

    芊芊看到墨非夜的眼神，从期待变得暗淡，记起墨攻行刚才说过，在最后时刻。是被玉京子从梦中甩出。

    “既然玉京子可以，那瑶必定也可以。”芊芊心想，于是从怀里掏出胭脂，递到玉京子跟前。

    “你让瑶帮帮我们，这个就给你。”

    玉京子看着胭脂，一副跃跃欲试，却左右为难的样子。

    “只需要在最凶险的时候，能把他送出来。”芊芊把胭脂往前送了送，示意玉京子收下。

    玉京子见状，毫不客气地将胭脂收入囊中，“我会尽量帮你们，可不能打包票，瑶会答应。”

    将几人安排妥当后，玉京子就迫不及待，再次与瑶在梦里相会。

    “她答应了，她答应了。”芊芊迷迷糊糊听到，玉京子的声音。

    也许在漫长的岁月中，过于的无聊，也许出于报恩的心态，瑶收到几人的请求后，一口就答应了下来。

    在接下来的几日中，还进入墨攻行的梦境，好好地聊了聊，从他嘴里，了解事情的缘由。

    在得知芊芊有红蓝花，瑶就想跑到芊芊梦里去会会她，两人好好讨论一下妆容。

    “梦里找我，可我从来不做梦。”听到瑶想到梦里找自己，芊芊对玉京子说。

    “怎么可能，你明明磨牙说梦话。”在墨攻行亲眼所见，就连睡觉都不会让芊芊住嘴。

    “那又怎么样，我确实从来不做梦。”

    “不做梦，怎么说梦话？”

    “我从来不做梦，我睡着了就是单纯地说话。是你说的，我嘴巴不动就痒。”

    “我不信，我不信。有种你把这茶喝了。”墨攻行拿起旁边的茶壶，里面装的是玉红草茶。

    玉红草是一种，生长在白玉京的仙草，传说中吃下一颗能沉睡三百年。实际上虽达不到，传说中的效果，但是让食用者睡上十天半个月，一点问题都没有。

    以玉红草为原料，煮出的茶水，就是玉红草茶，只要一小口，就可以让人马上入睡。
content_en:
"I remembered. This bird has always seemed familiar to me. No wonder." Mo Gongxing patted his head and continued: "Back then, the Nuo team in Wulucheng had masks with this kind of mask. Because the beak was very big, I had an impression of it."

    "Well, the Birch bird is one of the twelve beasts. Because it eats dreams, it is used to kill dream demons." Yu Jingzi said.

    "Yeah! Then if I use him at night, I don't have to dream." Qianqian looked a little excited.

    "I guess it won't work just by painting. Yao's situation is very special. Ordinary people can't compare with her." Yu Jingzi shook her head.

    "Then can you lend us the Huaimencao, and I can go into his dream and have a look." Mo Gongxing looked at Yu Jingzi.

    "There is no problem with this, but I advise you not to do this." Yu Jingzi's expression was extremely serious.

    "Gu has been in the heavenly realm for many years, and his character has been determined. Under Yao's teachings over the years, he has become very strong in controlling dreams. Even so, there are still some deviations. I originally wanted to send you directly to Yunmeng Terrace, but in the end Burial Cloud Mountain and Yu Mountain still appeared."

    "Even I am like this. You ordinary people's dreams are even more conceivable. The content is bizarre and elusive. If it is a nightmare, it is even more dangerous. If the mental power is trapped in the dream, the consequences will be disastrous, ranging from dementia to death on the spot."

    Mo Feiye looked relaxed when he saw Mo Gongxing, but he didn't expect that falling into a dream would be so dangerous.

    He could only recall fragments of the nightmare that had plagued him for so long. If you can really go in and take a look, you might be able to know the truth about your nightmare.

    Maybe we can also unlock the secret of the disappearance of all living things in Tucheng.

    Now that I heard that Mo Gengxing would be in danger of life and death, I couldn't let Mo Gengxing take such a big risk.

    Qianqian saw Mo Feiye's eyes dimming from anticipation, and remembered what Mo Gongxing had just said, at the last moment. He was thrown out of his dream by Yu Jingzi.

    "Since Yu Jingzi can do it, then Yao must also be able to do it." Qianqian thought to herself, so she took out the rouge from her arms and handed it to Yu Jingzi.

    "Ask Yao to help us, and I'll give this to you."

    Yu Jingzi looked at Yanzhi, looking eager to try, but in a dilemma.

    "I just need to be able to send him out at the most dangerous moment." Qianqian sent Yanzhi forward and signaled to Yu Jingzi to accept it.

    Seeing this, Yu Jingzi unceremoniously took Rouge into her pocket, "I will try my best to help you, but I can't guarantee that Yao will agree."

    After arranging a few people, Yu Jingzi couldn't wait to meet Yao in her dream again.

    "She agreed, she agreed." Qianqian vaguely heard Yu Jingzi's voice.

    Perhaps she was too bored during the long years, or perhaps out of a desire to repay a favor, Yao agreed immediately after receiving requests from several people.

    In the next few days, I also entered Mo Gongxing's dream, had a good chat, and learned the reason for the matter from his mouth.

    After learning that Qianqian has red and blue flowers, Yao wanted to go to Qianqian's dream to meet her, and the two of them would have a good discussion about makeup.

    "Looking for me in dreams, but I never dream." Qianqian said to Yu Jingzi after hearing that Yao thought of looking for herself in dreams.

    "How is that possible? You are grinding your teeth and talking in your sleep." Zai Mo Gongxing saw with his own eyes that Qianqian would not shut up even when sleeping.

    "So what, I never dream."

    "If you don't dream, how can you talk in your sleep?"

    "I never dream. I just talk when I'm asleep. It's you who told me that my mouth feels itchy when I don't move."

    "I don't believe it, I don't believe it. If you dare, drink this tea." Mo Gongxing picked up the teapot next to him, which contained jade red grass tea.

    Yuhongcao is a kind of fairy grass that grows in Baiyujing. Legend has it that one can sleep for three hundred years if one eats one. In fact, although it cannot achieve the legendary effect, there is no problem at all in allowing users to sleep for ten days and a half.

    The tea brewed with Yuhongcao as raw material is Yuhongcao tea. Just a small sip can make people fall asleep immediately.
title_en: Chapter 30: Falling into a dream but not at night
